description: This file defines a React component for a Tic Tac Toe game themed with horses and pawns, including game logic, UI rendering, and interaction handlers.

methods.name: checkWinner
methods.description: Calculates the winner of the Tic Tac Toe game by checking all winning combinations on the board.

methods.name: isDraw
methods.description: Determines if the game is a draw by checking if all cells are filled and there is no winner.

methods.name: ChessIcon
methods.description: React component that renders Unicode icons for horses and pawns with styling.

methods.name: Home
methods.description: Main React functional component implementing the game UI, state management, and user interactions.
